items.title: 4.2 Biology mein bonds ki qismein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.2, printed pages 93-94.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif qisam ke bonds aur taalluqat (interactions) hayatiyati (biological) molecules ki banawat (structure) aur kaam (function) mein nihayat aham kirdar ada karte hain. Carbon organic molecules ka bunyadi element hai. Yeh tetravalent hai aur H, O, N, P aur S jaise bohat se doosre elements se reaction kar sakta hai. Carbon-hydrogen bond (C-H bond) cell ki sargarmiyon ke liye kemiyai tawanai (chemical energy) ka mumkina zariya hai. Glycosidic linkages mein carbon-oxygen ka jor pecheeda (complex) carbohydrate molecules ko istehkam (stability) deta hai. Carbon amino acid linkages mein nitrogen se mil kar peptide bonds banata hai aur yun proteins banate hain, jo apni banawat aur kaam ki tanawwo (diversity) ki wajah se bohat aham hain.
Covalent bonds tab bante hain jab do atoms electrons share karte hain. Yeh bonds aksar proteins aur nucleic acids jaise organic molecules mein milte hain aur molecules ko istehkam dete hain.

Ionic bonds tab bante hain jab ek atom electron deta hai (aur musbat ion, cation, banta hai) aur doosra atom electron leta hai (aur manfi ion, anion, banta hai). In mukhalif charge wale ions ke darmiyan electrostatic kashish (attraction) ionic bond banati hai. Ionic bonds thos (solid) halat mein nisbatan mazboot hote hain aur zyada tar sodium chloride jaise inorganic molecules mein bante hain.

Hydrogen bonds ek hydrogen atom aur ek electronegative atom (jaise oxygen ya nitrogen) ke darmiyan kamzor kashish hain. Yeh bonds proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare molecules ki banawat qaim rakhne mein, aur DNA replication jaise mukhtalif hayatiyati amal mein aham hain.

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Baen, covalent bond: do hydrogen atoms ek doosre par chadh kar electrons ka ek jora share karte hain. Darmiyan, ionic bond: ek electron sodium atom se chlorine atom ko jata hai, jis se musbat sodium ion manfi chloride ion ko khenchta hai. Daen, hydrogen bond: ek nuqtedar lakeer ek pani ke molecule ke juzvi musbat hydrogen ko doosre ke juzvi manfi oxygen se jorti hai.
blocks.caption: Covalent, ionic aur hydrogen bonds (Figures 4.1 se 4.3 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Covalent bond mein do atoms electrons ka ek jora share karte hain; yeh mazboot hai aur proteins aur nucleic acids jaise organic molecules ko jore rakhta hai, aur C-H bonds kemiyai tawanai zakheera karte hain. Ionic bond mein ek atom electron de kar cation banta hai aur doosra le kar anion; mukhalif charges ki kashish hi bond hai, thos mein mazboot aur sodium chloride jaise inorganic molecules ki khaas. Hydrogen bond hydrogen atom aur electronegative oxygen ya nitrogen ke darmiyan kamzor kashish hai; yeh proteins ki shakal, DNA ka double helix qaim rakhta hai aur pani ke molecules ko jorta hai.

blocks.text: Hydrophobic taalluqat non-polar molecules aur polar molecules (jaise pani) ke darmiyan hote hain. Non-polar molecules pani wale mahol mein ikatthe ho jate hain taake pani ke molecules se rabta kam se kam ho. Yeh amal proteins ke folding aur cell membranes mein lipid bilayers banne ke liye nihayat zaroori hai.

Hydrophilic taalluqat polar molecules aur pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hote hain. Yeh polar aur ionic compounds ke pani mein hal hone ke liye zaroori hain, aur ghizai ajza (nutrients) ki tarseel (transport) aur cells ke andar kemiyai reactions jaise mukhtalif hayatiyati amal mein madad karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si ek qisam ka bond DNA ke do strands ko jore rakhta hai, aur woh bond kamzor hone ke bawajood molecule kyun nahin bikharta?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonds strands ko jore rakhte hain. Har ek kamzor hai, magar molecule ki lambai mein yeh bohat zyada tadaad mein hain, aur strands khud mazboot covalent bonds se jure hain, is liye double helix mustahkam bhi hai aur replication ke liye khola bhi ja sakta hai.

items: Carbon tetravalent hai; C-H bonds tawanai zakheera karte hain, C-O jor carbohydrates ko mustahkam karte hain, C-N peptide bonds proteins banate hain.

Covalent bonds electrons share karte hain (mazboot, organic molecules); ionic bonds electrons muntaqil karte hain (cation aur anion, NaCl); hydrogen bonds H ki O ya N se kamzor kashish hain (protein ki shakal, DNA).
Hydrophobic taalluqat non-polar molecules ko pani se door ikattha karte hain (protein folding, bilayers); hydrophilic taalluqat polar aur ionic compounds ko hal karte hain.
